project.task: RSNA pediatric bone-age regression in months
project.short_term_goal: Improve MAE using development-only selection and extend the margin over the 4.42-month target paper

definitions.E1_P7: Full-image ConvNeXt-Tiny, ImageNet-1K pretrained, global average pooling, final LayerNorm, sex embedding, direct regression, A2 augmentation, 512 px
definitions.C3_ROI_V1: Hand segmentation bounding-box ROI with 8 percent margin; full-image fallback
definitions.C3_R2: Rebuilt ROI with 12 percent margin and border rescue; not Z26-preprocessed by default
definitions.Z26_HE: Aspect-ratio-preserving resize/padding plus histogram equalization and black canvas
definitions.Z26_NO_HE: Same resize/padding and black canvas without histogram equalization
definitions.TTA: Mean of 10 views: rotations -10,-5,0,5,10 degrees crossed with flip/no-flip
definitions.OOF: Each development sample predicted only by a fold that did not fit that sample

screening.protocol: Matched raw C3-R2, Fold 1-2 only, no test access

bram_2025.note: Five-fold ensemble; 35 abnormal cases excluded from train/validation

zhang_2026.note: Not directly comparable with test-200 results

current_decisions: Keep C3-ROI V1 as the stable test baseline
Do not promote histogram equalization, C3-R2 Z26, or bilinear pooling
Diagnose and finish C1 on matched Fold 1-2
Run C2 ConvNeXt V2 only after the C1 decision
Promote candidates using validation or OOF only
hard_rules: Do not select preprocessing, models, checkpoints, TTA, calibration, or ensemble weights using RSNA test labels
Do not compare validation-1425, OOF-14036, and test-200 as the same cohort
Do not label partial logs as final results
Do not claim state of the art or external generalization

archive_policy.p14_temp_delete_condition: Delete only when its 99_CLEANUP_AFTER_P14.md condition is satisfied
